outcome: Obstetric outcomes (vaginal delivery, cesarean section, preterm delivery, fetal distress)
cohort: 80 infertile women of reproductive age with at least one large uterine myoma (diameter >=5 cm) undergoing myomectomy.
finding: Laparoscopic myomectomy (LM) resulted in a shorter hospital stay and better post-operative outcome compared to abdominal myomectomy (AM), with comparable results in restoring fertility and pregnancy success.
mod_finding: In the laparoscopic myomectomy group, 29.4% of deliveries were vaginal, while 64.7% were cesarean sections, with some cesarean sections attributed to preterm delivery or fetal distress.
